accounting_model.machine: 128-bit word RAM with a flat 2^128-word address space and abstract contiguous-array allocation
time_charges: One complete one-block SHA-1 evaluation costs one time unit.
Each other 128-bit word-RAM primitive operation also costs one time unit; this deliberately overcharges ordinary operations relative to SHA-1 compression.
accounting_model.memory_charge: Count every simultaneously live byte, including buffers, tables, metadata, array descriptors, messages, digests, and fixed program state. Abstract array allocation uses one 128-bit descriptor and no hidden allocator arena.

requirements: Time includes candidate generation, filtering, verification, and repetitions needed to reach the claimed success probability.
Memory is peak simultaneously live memory and includes stored messages, digests, tables, solver state, and device memory.
Data, preprocessing, reusable advice, parallelism, communication, and hardware assumptions are reported separately.
A lower scalar does not erase restrictions or permit a dominated full cost vector.
